effects.printed_clause: Except during the Battle Phase, this card cannot be Summoned while you control a monster, except by a Tribute Summon whose required Tributes are the only monsters you control.
effects.lua_implementation: add_lv5_summon_limit registers CANNOT_SUMMON/CANNOT_FLIP_SUMMON outside the Battle Phase when too many monsters remain, and SPSUMMON_CONDITION permits Special Summon only in the Battle Phase or with an empty field.

official_references.card_name: The Last Warrior from Another Planet
official_references.matched_structure: The Last Warrior from Another Planet supplies official field-based summon-prohibition structures; Lunalie specializes those checks to its own summon procedure.
official_references.official_effect_text:
"Zombyra the Dark" + "Maryokutai"
If this card is Special Summoned: [b]Destroy[/b] all other monsters you control. Neither player can Summon monsters.

effects.printed_clause: You can Normal Summon/Set this card in addition to your Normal Summon/Set; only one such additional count can be gained per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: add_extra_summon registers targeted EFFECT_EXTRA_SUMMON_COUNT and EFFECT_EXTRA_SET_COUNT while Lunalie is in hand/field.

official_references.matched_structure: Gem-Knight Seraphinite uses EFFECT_EXTRA_SUMMON_COUNT for the same once-per-turn additional Normal Summon/Set rule.
official_references.official_effect_text:
1 "Gem-Knight" monster + 1 LIGHT monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned with the above Fusion Materials. During your [b]Main Phase[/b], [b]you can[/b] Normal Summon/Set 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. ([b]You can[/b] only gain this effect [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].)

effects.printed_clause: Tribute this card; add 1 "Domestica" card from your GY to your hand, then you can send 1 card from your hand to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: cost releases the handler; thtg/thop select a Necrovalley-legal Domestica in the GY, add it, then optionally select and send one hand card.

official_references.matched_structure: Lonefire Blossom uses self-Tribute as an activation cost; the target/operation split is the same official cost structure.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]: [b]You can[/b] Tribute 1 face-up Plant monster; Special Summon 1 Plant monster from your Deck.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use the Tribute/recovery effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: e3 uses SetCountLimit(1,id), a shared-name hard once-per-turn key.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring uses SetCountLimit(1,id) for a named hard once-per-turn effect.
official_references.official_effect_text:
[b]When[/b] a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]discard[/b] this card; [b]negate[/b] that effect.
● Add a card from the Deck to the hand.
● Special Summon from the Deck.
● Send a card from the Deck to the GY.
[b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: Reveal 1 Beast or Winged Beast Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and 1 Fusion Material listed on it in your Deck, then send that Extra Deck monster to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: exfilter limits the revealed Extra Deck card to a Beast/Winged Beast Fusion able to go to GY and requires a listed Deck material; activate confirms both cards, shuffles after revealing the Deck card, and sends only the Fusion.

official_references.matched_structure: Ojamassimilation uses an Extra Deck reveal plus specifically listed Fusion Material checks via official material-list helpers.
official_references.official_effect_text: Reveal 1 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck [b]and[/b] [b]banish[/b] any number of "Ojama" monsters from your hand, face-up field, [b]and[/b]/or GY; Special Summon Fusion Materials with different names whose names are specifically listed on the card you revealed, from your hand, Deck, [b]and[/b]/or GY, equal to the number of monsters banished to activate this effect. [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your GY, [b]then[/b] [b]target[/b] 3 of your banished "Ojama" monsters; shuffle them into the Deck, [b]then[/b] draw 1 card.

effects.printed_clause: You can only activate 1 "Domestication" per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation effect uses SetCountLimit(1,id+EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH).

official_references.matched_structure: Pot of Desires uses an oath-style card-activation count limit.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Banish[/b] 10 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down; draw 2 cards. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Pot of Desires" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: If a card would be sent from your hand to the GY by card effect, you can shuffle this card from your GY into the Deck instead.
effects.lua_implementation: EFFECT_SEND_REPLACE watches effect-reason sends from the controller’s hand, lets the player choose one affected card, and sends Domestication from GY to the shuffled Deck with REASON_REPLACE.

official_references.matched_structure: Meklord Deflection uses an official GY replacement operation that substitutes banishing itself for another pending event.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 1 "Meklord" monster you control; your opponent takes no battle damage from attacks involving that face-up monster until the end of this turn, [b]also[/b] its ATK becomes (permanently) the combined original ATK of all "Meklord" monsters you currently control. If a "Meklord" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, [b]you can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your GY [b]instead[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Meklord Deflection" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: If a Level 1 Beast or Winged Beast is sent from your hand to the GY, once per turn: shuffle that card into the Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_TO_GRAVE with DELAY checks previous hand/controller, Level 1 and race; the selected event card is returned with Necrovalley handling and e1 has a once-per-turn key.

official_references.matched_structure: Guiding Ariadne demonstrates delayed previous-location event filtering and returning an event card as part of resolution.

effects.printed_clause: Then add a differently named Level 1 Beast or Winged Beast from your Deck, and if you do, you can send it to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: The returned card’s code is captured, the Deck search excludes that code, confirms the added card, then optionally sends that same card.

official_references.matched_structure: Swap Frog supplies official Level/race/type Deck filtering and optional send-to-GY follow-up structure.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 other WATER monster. [b]When[/b] this card is Summoned: [b]You can[/b] send 1 Level 2 or lower WATER Aqua monster from your Deck or face-up field to the GY. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]: [b]You can[/b] [b]return[/b] 1 monster you control to the hand; [b]you can[/b] Normal Summon 1 "Frog" monster during your [b]Main Phase[/b] this turn, except "Swap Frog", in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. ([b]You can[/b] only gain this effect [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].)

effects.printed_clause: At the start of the Battle Phase, if you control no monsters, Special Summon any number of differently named "Domestica" Fairy monsters from your GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A forced PHASE_BATTLE_START trigger rechecks an empty field, computes open zones, and SelectSubGroup enforces distinct codes for one through all available zones.

official_references.matched_structure: Soul Charge provides official multi-monster GY Special Summon selection constrained by available monster zones.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] any number of monsters in your GY; Special Summon them, [b]and if you do[/b], you lose 1000 LP for each monster Special Summoned by this effect. You [b]cannot[/b] conduct your [b]Battle Phase[/b] the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Soul Charge" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: Send those summoned monsters to the GY at the end of that Battle Phase.
effects.lua_implementation: Each successfully summoned monster receives a standard-reset PHASE_BATTLE continuous effect that sends itself at that phase’s end.

official_references.matched_structure: Raidraptor - Last Strix registers a delayed phase cleanup for a monster Special Summoned by its effect.

[b]You can[/b] Tribute this card; your opponent takes no battle damage this turn, [b]also[/b] you Special Summon 1 "Raidraptor" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position, but its effects are negated, [b]also[/b] [b]return[/b] it to the Extra Deck during the [b]End Phase[/b]. effects.printed_clause: Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this effect’s activation.
effects.lua_implementation: The target function calls Duel.SetChainLimit(aux.FALSE).

official_references.matched_structure: Super Polymerization uses Duel.SetChainLimit(aux.FALSE) to prevent either player chaining to the activation.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Discard[/b] 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

effects.lua_implementation: A hand-range EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_SUM returns true only for NATURE tribute-summon candidates and has its own HOPT key.

You can only use 1 "Sinful Spoils Awakening" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

effects.printed_clause: If Set by that effect, this Set card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

2+ Effect Monsters
Your opponent [b]cannot[/b] activate cards or effects in response to this card's effect activations. [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] 1 Link Monster from your field or GY; [b]destroy[/b] 1 card your opponent controls, [b]also[/b] for the rest of this turn, you [b]cannot[/b] [b]banish[/b] monsters with that same Attribute to activate this effect of "Accesscode Talker".

effects.issue: The printed wording has no semicolon before the placement and says 'then target' after that operation, so it describes placement during resolution followed by target selection, which standard chain targeting cannot do. P

E
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters

[b]When[/b] this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: [b]You can[/b] halve your opponent's LP. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] place this card in your Pendulum Zone.
